patForm.description: Drive the classic Personal Access Token form: open the prefilled URL, set description + expiration through the native input setter, ensure the requested scopes are checked, click Generate, extract the ghp_ token by regex. Stops on a 'Confirm access' sudo re-auth page rather than clicking through it.

expirationLabel.description: visible label to click, default "No expiration"

returns.description: {token} on success; {stop, ...} on sudo / missing scopes / no button / token not found
